root_cause: The repository contains a mechanically invalid concatenated legacy Base64 transport and a valid four-part Base64/GZIP transport. The prior loader rejected the four-part transport before decompression because its GZIP wrapper hash differed, even though the preregistered executable identity is the decompressed Python byte stream.
correction: Decode and decompress every syntactically valid repository transport before deciding identity.
Accept a transport only when both the preregistered raw byte count 42628 and raw SHA-256 a87613b623f0b228ca9a7eb365e2fe462efffd51dbcfa06d1b948061fe5e742d match exactly.
Continue to report the legacy Base64 and GZIP wrapper hashes as transport diagnostics, but do not treat a wrapper-only mismatch as a scientific-code mismatch.
